name: Community Tests (No Secrets)

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - dev

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  code_quality:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .[dev]
      - name: Run pre-commit
        run: pre-commit run --all-files
      - name: Run ruff check
        run: ruff check . --output-format=github
      - name: Run ruff format
        run: ruff format . --check

  unit_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .[dev]
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: |
          pytest -q --junitxml=pytest.xml \
            tests/unit/processing \
            tests/unit/graph \
            tests/unit/chunking \
            tests/unit/retrieval \
            tests/unit/search \
            tests/unit/pipelines \
            tests/unit/visualization \
            tests/unit/ontology \
            tests/unit/permissions \
            tests/unit/cache \
            tests/unit/session \
            tests/unit/config \
            tests/unit/eval_framework
      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: unit-test-results
          path: pytest.xml
      - name: Publish test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          artifact: unit-test-results
          name: Unit Tests
          path: pytest.xml
          reporter: java-junit

  cli_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .[dev]
      - name: Run CLI tests
        run: |
          pytest -q --junitxml=cli_pytest.xml tests/unit/cli
      - name: Upload CLI test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cli-test-results
          path: cli_pytest.xml
      - name: Publish CLI test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          artifact: cli-test-results
          name: CLI Tests
          path: cli_pytest.xml
          reporter: java-junit

  telemetry_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .[dev]
      - name: Run telemetry tests
        run: |
          pytest -q --junitxml=telemetry_pytest.xml tests/unit/telemetry
      - name: Upload telemetry test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: telemetry-test-results
          path: telemetry_pytest.xml
      - name: Publish telemetry test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          artifact: telemetry-test-results
          name: Telemetry Tests
          path: telemetry_pytest.xml
          reporter: java-junit
